title: Glowing hourglass
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='sandTop' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFD700'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFA500'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='sandBot' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFA500'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFD700'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='glass' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7FD4FF' stop-opacity='0.35'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#B0E8FF' stop-opacity='0.2'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#7FD4FF' stop-opacity='0.35'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Glow aura behind glass -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='36' ry='38' fill='#FFD700' opacity='0.08'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='26' ry='32' fill='#FFD700' opacity='0.1'/>

  <!-- Top wooden cap -->
  <rect x='28' y='8' width='44' height='9' rx='3' fill='#C97A2E'/>
  <rect x='30' y='10' width='40' height='5' rx='2' fill='#E8933A'/>

  <!-- Bottom wooden cap -->
  <rect x='28' y='83' width='44' height='9' rx='3' fill='#C97A2E'/>
  <rect x='30' y='85' width='40' height='5' rx='2' fill='#E8933A'/>

  <!-- Glass body - top bulb -->
  <path d='M34,17 L34,30 Q34,50 50,50 Q66,50 66,30 L66,17' fill='url(#glass)' stroke='#A8D8F0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Glass body - bottom bulb -->
  <path d='M34,83 L34,70 Q34,50 50,50 Q66,50 66,70 L66,83' fill='url(#glass)' stroke='#A8D8F0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Sand in top bulb -->
  <path d='M37,28 L37,40 Q37,48 50,48 Q63,48 63,40 L63,28 Z' fill='url(#sandTop)'/>

  <!-- Sand in bottom bulb -->
  <path d='M37,72 Q37,52 50,52 Q63,52 63,72 L63,82 L37,82 Z' fill='url(#sandBot)'/>

  <!-- Falling sand stream -->
  <line x1='50' y1='48' x2='50' y2='60' stroke='#FFD700' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='48' x2='50' y2='60' stroke='#FFED8A' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Sand pile mound in bottom -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='10' ry='4' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='10' ry='4' fill='#FFED8A' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Sparkle glints on glass -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='24' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='22' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='76' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='78' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Neck narrow part highlight -->
  <rect x='48' y='48' width='4' height='4' rx='1' fill='#FFD700' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- Small sparkles around -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='35' r='1' fill='#FFED8A' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='62' r='1' fill='#FFED8A' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='30' r='0.8' fill='#FFED8A' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='68' r='0.8' fill='#FFED8A' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Cross sparkle top left -->
  <g opacity='0.6' fill='#FFED8A'>
    <rect x='20' y='18' width='6' height='1.5' rx='0.75'/>
    <rect x='22.25' y='15.75' width='1.5' height='6' rx='0.75'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Cross sparkle bottom right -->
  <g opacity='0.6' fill='#FFED8A'>
    <rect x='74' y='72' width='6' height='1.5' rx='0.75'/>
    <rect x='76.25' y='69.75' width='1.5' height='6' rx='0.75'/>
  </g>
</svg>
